description:
Add TraceLayer from tower-http to build_router so every HTTP request gets a root span. Extract inbound W3C traceparent/tracestate headers to continue an existing trace (required for distributed tracing across a load balancer or API gateway).

## What to do in build_router (server.rs)

  1. Add TraceLayer:
     tower_http::trace::TraceLayer::new_for_http()
       .make_span_with(|req: &Request<_>| {
           tracing::info_span!(
               "http_request",
               http.method = %req.method(),
               http.route  = %req.uri().path(),    // path only, no query (avoids PII)
               http.status_code = tracing::field::Empty,  // filled on response
           )
       })
       .on_response(|resp, latency, span: &Span| {
           span.record("http.status_code", resp.status().as_u16());
       })

  2. Add W3C TraceContext propagation via an axum middleware that reads
     'traceparent' and 'tracestate' headers and sets the OTEL context
     before the handler runs, so the TraceLayer span is a child of the
     upstream trace rather than a new root.

  3. Exclude /health and /metrics from tracing (high-frequency polling
     will flood traces with noise; use a filter in the TraceLayer).

## Why path only, not full URI
Query strings frequently contain user-supplied data (search terms, IDs)
that must not appear in trace metadata sent to a third-party collector.
Path is safe; query is not.

## Placement in the layer stack
TraceLayer must be the OUTERMOST layer (added last) so the span wraps
auth middleware and all handlers. If placed inside the auth layer the
span won't include auth latency, which is misleading for latency analysis.

## Acceptance
- Each request to /jmap/api produces a span with http.method, http.route, http.status_code
- A request with a valid traceparent header produces a child span, not a new root (verify with otel-jaeger or a test subscriber that checks parent_span_id)
- /health requests do not produce spans
title: Add tower-http TraceLayer to axum router with W3C TraceContext propagation
